budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver six total fruit portions through individual owner stalls or the community barn while growing saplings, managing shade, water and finite planting beds.
task.natural_termination: Success when private plus community deliveries total at least six. Failure only when every plant identity is dead and no gardener carries fruit, with success taking priority if already achieved.
task.interaction: A screen's actual footprint protects a young neighbor from hot-phase stress while denying light to mature trees in that column. Rotating, carrying or dropping screens changes peer growth and heat exposure. One shared water cart, spring regeneration and a single carrying slot compete with planting, harvest and private/community delivery.
task.observation_access: Fully observable. All fields in obs_keys are public after the role one-hot, including actual base/derived terrain, explicit shade_map footprint, screen positions and orientations, carriers, planting identities/owners/beds/stages/water/stress/growth, spring stocks, fruit inventory and destination accounting. Derived shaded tiles and plant flags come from the same native footprint used by heat and growth transitions. No independent browser shade model or hidden crop planner exists.

native_event_definitions.meaning: 0 morning, 1 hot, 2 late day, 3 night; each lasts four raw ticks.
Saplings placed into beds this step.
Plants receiving cart water this step.
Plants generating a new ripe portion this step.
Private-stall deliveries this step by original owner.
Community-barn deliveries this step by original owner.
Cumulative generated ripe fruit per plant identity.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
